snippet.title: Amnesia Fortnight 2026 Pitches: Plot Armor
snippet.description:
*Plot Armor*
Presented By: Lauren Scott

Plot Armor is a turn-based RPG / visual novel combo in which your narrative choices in the latter affect your characters’ performance in the former. Characters who are involved in juicy storylines receive combat buffs to reduce their chances of dying, and characters who are neglected narratively are vulnerable to being killed off in battles.

*What is an Amnesia Fortnight?*

Amnesia Fortnight is a type of game jam and a long standing tradition of ours.  It's a two week period (fortnight) in which we forget about the all things we should be working on to pitch one another our wildest game ideas, choose our very favorites, and make prototypes of them. It's fun! It's stressful! It's pretty incredible what you can make in just two weeks!

This time we're asking YOU to choose which things we should make! Check out our Kickstarter to learn more and find out how to vote on your favorites: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/doublefine/amnesia-fortnight-2026-indie-reboot 

*Disclaimer:* This is a game pitch! That means some of the concepts are in very early stages and a lot of it is subject to change as the game enters actual, real, tangible development. It also means that things like the art style, music, and even vibes might change as a team forms behind the idea. Only four of these ideas will make it through though, so be sure to rally behind your favorites!
